reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals.

The cited text supports the preferred position: all grants to Corio (the customer-side party here) are expressly 'nonexclusive', and Section 2.7 is an ordinary licence-scope restriction rather than an exclusive-dealing covenant. No requirements or sole-supplier obligation binds Corio.

Exhibit D marketing cooperation is expressly 'non-binding' joint marketing, not exclusive dealing; Section 2.4's bar on Commerce One contacting Corio Customers runs in our favour and is correctly not flagged per the detection guidance.
Deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier/requirements obligation on Customer remains; rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
